name: High knees

phases.name: left up
phases.cue: Drive your left knee up to hip height

phases.name: left down
phases.cue: Land softly on the ball of your foot

phases.name: right up
phases.cue: Drive your right knee up, opposite arm forward

phases.name: right down
phases.cue: Land softly and keep the rhythm quick

formTips: Bring each knee up to about hip height
Stay tall with your chest up and core braced
Pump your arms, opposite arm to knee
Land lightly on the balls of your feet
commonMistakes: Leaning back to get the knees higher
